title: Normalized derived adjunction for a specified cochain left derived pair
statement: Let E:A→B and V:B→A be an additive adjunction E⊣V between abelian categories, with V exact. Choose independent derived categories and a universal cochain left derived pair (F,ε) for E. Suppose a class P resolves every complex by a quasi-isomorphism and ε is invertible on P. Then F is left adjoint to the exact derived V, and at every complex K the derived unit followed by V^D(ε_K) and the exact comparison equals Q of the termwise ordinary unit.

source.place: Tags 0FND, 09T5, 06XN and 05SU; derived adjunction and universal cochain counit.

proof.text: Precompose the homotopy universal problem with the full homotopy quotient, using the quotient/localization comparisons; fullness and faithfulness reflect the universal property, yielding the counit on homotopy categories. The images of P form a resolving class on which that counit is invertible. Naturality shows E followed by localization inverts quasi-isomorphisms between its members. Resolving-class essential constancy supplies the left denominator diagrams. Exact V inverts all quasi-isomorphisms; inverse images of denominators give constant right denominator diagrams. Apply the proved derived-adjunction compatibility theorem. Evaluate its representative formula at the identity to get the homotopy unit equation. The quotient/localization and exact-functor comparisons transport this equation to the specified cochain unit formula.

theorem exists_cochainDerivedAdjunction
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type u'} [Category.{v'} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} B]
    (E : A ⥤ B) [E.Additive] (V : B ⥤ A) [V.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V] (adj : E ⊣ V)
    (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶ E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ))]
    (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex A ℤ))
    (hres : ∀ K, ∃ (L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (p : L ⟶ K), P L ∧ QuasiIso p)
    (hε : ∀ K, P K → IsIso (ε.app K)) :
    ∃ d : F ⊣ V.mapDerivedCategory,
      ∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
        d.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫ V.mapDerivedCategory.map (ε.app K) ≫
          V.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app K)
